title: Argus consumer config
description: One file per solution, committed in the anchor repo. All product facts, policies and rules live here. Paths are relative to this file.

facts_path.description: Optional. File of product facts the agent reads during discovery.

orchestration_dir.description: Where Argus writes status.md, parking-list.md and per-story folders.

requirements_dir.description: Optional. Where requirements.md lives. Default: <orchestration_dir>/<issue>/. Argus reads it, never owns it.

template_dir.description: Optional. Files here shadow same-named files under argus/templates/.

anchor.description: Key in `repos` that holds this config.

repos.description: Every repo in the solution, keyed by a short name.

path.description: Path to the repo root, relative to this file.

role.description: Free text, e.g. ui, service, database.

test_command.description: Command the worker runs. Never assumed when absent.

rules_path.description: Rules file or directory, relative to the repo root.

repo.description: owner/name of the repo holding epics and stories.

policies.description: Standing policies the agent never re-asks. See discovery/standing-policies.md.

prompt_token_budget.description: Max estimated tokens for a generated worker prompt.

models.description: Optional per-role model hints passed to the host adapter.

primary.description: Optional. Path to a primary solution's config. Cross-solution exports go there.
